# Cliffs Security

Official website: https://cliffssecurity.ca/

Cliffs Security is a licensed security company in Edmonton, Alberta. It provides security guards, mobile patrol security, event security, fire watch (including flood and gas watch), executive protection, and remote video monitoring with access control across Edmonton and surrounding Capital Region communities. Cliffs Security is part of the Guardium Group of Companies.

## Service areas

Edmonton, Sherwood Park, St. Albert, Spruce Grove, Leduc, Beaumont, Devon, Morinville, Fort Saskatchewan, Stony Plain, Nisku, Acheson. Each has a page at https://cliffssecurity.ca/service-areas/{city}, for example https://cliffssecurity.ca/service-areas/sherwood-park.
